title: Customer authentication, risk-based step-up and recovery
workflow: Authenticate customer under approved OIDC and device posture rules
Evaluate action risk, session age and product-specific controls
Issue short-lived challenge bound to account, recipient, amount and command identity
Verify challenge on trusted server against immutable transaction digest
Grant narrowly scoped one-use authorization and execute original request
On recovery, verify ownership and revoke compromised sessions/devices
invariants: One-time challenge cannot authorize changed transfer parameters
No SMS/biometric factor is universally mandated without risk and policy review
Credential reset does not silently remove financial restrictions
Account recovery cannot bypass independent high-risk approval
Browser/mobile clients cannot self-assert authentication strength
All challenge attempts and failures are rate limited and audited
Expired token or revoked device cannot approve a new payment
acceptance_tests: Insufficient factor leads to explicit challenge
Cross-bank session cannot authorize target account
independent_gate: Bank IAM and identity proofing policy, real strong-auth controls and approved security/UX testing.
